verdict.rationale: The models page states the context budget precisely: 64k tokens per request, 32k tokens for `state` plus the longest question, and the 64k budget covers state plus all questions combined. That is exact token accounting, not a marketing range. The SDK also exposes per-call input-token usage, and one endpoint serves every listed model, selected by the `model` field. Missing for 10: an explicit output-token limit (the docs only say output tokens are free), confirmation that limits are stated separately for each versioned model ID, and independent hands-on corroboration of the limits.
